The stain was evaluated using the modified scoring criteria for gastric/gastroesophageal junction cancer, based on Trastuzumab for Gastric Cancer trial.
in_text_mentions: All NM were negative for Her-2 (IHC score: 0). BE showed low expression of Her-2 (IHC score: 1+) in 13/50 (26%) of cases. In LGD, Her-2 overexpression was found in 12/49 (24.5%) of cases (IHC score: 1+). In HGD and in ICA, we found overexpression of Her-2 (IHC score: 2–3+) in 14/50 (28%) and 12/50 (24%) of cases, respectively (Figs. 1A–D). Differences in IHC scores between NM or BE and HGD and ICA were statistically significant (P = 0.02).
